text_block_list.text:
This result was made possible only through 
your hard work.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Ufufu. Thank you very much for working so 
hard.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
"I'm so happy everyone gets to see how 
wonderful you are too, Trainer♪"

A Trainer who is capable of showing such 
deep consideration for others...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I truly, truly believe that you are a 
wonderful person.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
"I'll do my best next time too so Trainer 
can be happy♪"

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
My... You're already thinking about what 
comes next.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
As expected of you, Trainer. I think that 
is truly admirable.

text_block_list.text:
"I'll get myself all fired up so I can 
support you too, Trainer♪"
